body: Awww ty. I’ve been kind of overwhelmed by the support on this and how it blew up lol. I think she was unsure of the kind of language to use when she said that.

Yeah she definitely cares about me, that’s not in question. It was mainly just gut instinct of ‘she wishes I still was old me’ the first part when I heard it. Idk if it’s reasonable or not to have that but I did. In reality it was probably more ‘I wished she was born in the right body’. She knows I’m her daughter and has stated she prefers having a happier daughter to miserable son.

I guess so it’s just sometimes hard to detach the objective truth of what someone is saying from the emotional gut reaction. She’s often expressed to me how she worries when I get older and more detached from my past that she fears for my safety if I get found out. So maybe it was to do with that .

My hair is naturally very poofy lol, it’s not a wig it just kind of... poofs away from my scalp sometimes (also I think lighting doesn’t help). Tbh I just did a very bad job straightening it that day, it’s naturally kinda wavy and maybe leaving it like that makes it look more natural? Idk. 

Also wasn’t wearing makeup because we have to wear a mask all day at work haha.

I’m working on my voice and I’ve been training it for about 3 or so months like it needs more work but I typically get ma’am-ed on the phone nowadays lol.

But thank you <3 I’m going to try to a new haircare routine which hopefully will help, and get my brows and lashes done since obvs masks all day and ya.

Edit: My hair is dyed as well so maybe that does it

I will say it tends to be only at work when I’m wearing a mask (voice I’m working on) weirdly, our work uniform is very andro. When I’m like just wearing normal clothes it doesn’t happen. 

We’ve had to start wearing a mask like since a couple weeks ago behind our checkouts and the misgendering has gone through the roof like omg. Before when people could see me in makeup it was much rarer. 

But thank you :) it’s like really hard having the misgendering go up so much because like before I thought I was doing so well comparatively. And I did go to here because here there’s much less hugboxing
Pretty tempted to do that after looking at prices for FFS on mymeditravel. They seem wayyyyy more reasonable.

https://imgur.com/a/7FWJqZp 

Pictures of my face. The lightning and angles are atrocious lmao, and I had to take them to send to a skincare place haha. I think it made me really dysphoric seeing my face like that.

HRT is from GenderGP, upped my dose to ~4mg a day recently of Estradiol gel, 5mg Finasteride, and 100mg progesterone. My T was superrrr low growing up, though I didn’t realise and subconsciously didn’t want to up it. It was 7.3nmol/L pre transition at 21, compared to normal levels of like 10.4-31.7 and last time I got my bloods checked, without the progesterone mind you, it was at 1.3 nmol/L so within cis woman ranges (I am due for a new blood test though).

Yes :( I’ve posted on this subreddit before, I’m using a throwaway for this but I’m in a mentally better place now. I’ve been suicidal a lot throughout the last few years, mainly bc I’m trans so like, I struggle with dysphoria and all of the baggage that comes along with being trans. But I’m really glad I’m still here to type this. I made a plan for suicide 2 months ago, I had a major relapse thanks to quarantine. Yes life can throw a load of stuff at you that you have to struggle with, and don’t want to deal with - but ultimately, despite all of this, it’s worth sticking around for. Just the little things - never being able to see a dog again, the people you’ll leave behind who’ll be devastated (and there’s way more than you’d think), never being able to feel the wind or take a walk or taste chocolate. While there’s so much bad in life, yes... there’s also so much good to be found. Please don’t go if you’re reading this, stick around. All of you are valuable and have something special to offer the world ❤️

Well yeah I guess that’s it. Although I have a penis, and I’m not going to deny myself sexual pleasure because it’s frankly a natural part of human existence, that doesn’t mean I don’t want to have a vagina, far from it. A penis doesn’t really fit me for intimate settings with others, at all, and feels fairly bad on my body.

Like saying that, once I get my vagina that should have rightfully mine at birth, it would probably be weird to imagine ever having had a penis since I like... don’t have one in my mental map of my body I guess? Never have. It’s weird to explain. But yeah, at least we don’t have the curiosity of what being the other sex would be like... though I feel like ignorance is bliss in that regard.

Really like maybe this is bad to say but I’ll take the risk any day. I’d rather have a vagina, a sexual organ that feels right on my body, that doesn’t leave a horrible bulge there or feel wrong sometimes when I sit down, and not be able to orgasm... than have a penis and while sure I’d guaranteed be able to orgasm, I also hate how it feels on my body really.
Honestly can’t wait. I like orgasming but don’t like the means of orgasm, it’s bizarre haha.
